cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hoped you'd retired it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hoped you'd retired it.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you. That means something.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.
